## notes
Same 1816 brown-ink hand as R9558/R9559. p1 lines 1-3: first 2-3 groups smeared by ink offset from the facing page (? marks). No interlinear.
5-digit strings: p1 l.1 18600, l.6 18641 (probably 1860 / 1864 + stray stroke).
p1 l.4 ends "82. 2." (short group 2). p1 l.5 last group 1099 (a stroke through the last digit).
p2 l.5 "207" has a dot/mark beneath it.
Recurrent strings: "964 742 723 1205" ends both p1 l.12 and p2 last line; "1123 337" x2.
